subject: Request: 15-minute infra compatibility check before Redwood demo
messages:
From: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@brightcart.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: 15-minute infra compatibility check before Redwood demo

Hi Marcus / Ben,

Thanks for the quick follow-up after our self-serve signup — I'm Alex on the BrightCart infra team. We're excited to evaluate Redwood, but before the product demo our engineering manager (cc'd) asked for a very short 15-minute technical compatibility check so we can confirm network/VPC constraints and expected model footprints.

Quick context: we plan to run inference against a small set of customer data in our US region (not PII). Our infra questions are mainly:
- Can Redwood Dedicated be reached from our VPC via PrivateLink or do we need an egress route?
- Any recommended model quantization for 8GB GPU pools?
- Does prefix/KV caching work with our streaming use case?

Would you be available for a 15-min slot this week? We prefer Americas-friendly hours (9am-2pm PT). I've attached a one-page network diagram and our minimal checklist.

Attachments: brightcart-network-overview.pdf

Thanks!
Alex Nguyen
Senior Platform Engineer, BrightCart
alex.nguyen@brightcart.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@brightcart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: 15-minute infra compatibility check before Redwood demo

Hi Alex — great to hear from you and thanks for the context and attachments. Happy to run a focused 15-min compatibility scan. A few quick asks upfront to make the call productive:
- Can you confirm whether you prefer PrivateLink or site-to-site VPN for connectivity?
- Approx sz of model/payload (tokens per request / batch size) so we can advise on batching/quant settings.

Available windows this week (PT):
- Tue 11/16 10:30–10:45
- Tue 11/16 13:00–13:15
- Wed 11/17 09:00–09:15

Please pick one and I will send a calendar invite. In the meantime I attached our one-page triage checklist that covers the usual network/KMS/tenant questions.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
(m) 415-555-0172
(attachment: redwood-triage-checklist.pdf)

Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: 15-minute infra compatibility check before Redwood demo

Thanks Marcus — Tue 11/16 10:30–10:45 PT works for us. For your prep notes:
- We'll use AWS PrivateLink when possible, fallback to site-to-site VPN if needed.
- Typical request is ~600 tokens, occasional bursts to 2k tokens; batch size usually 4–8.
- No customer PII in test payloads; data will be synthetic.

I've attached the network diagram for reference (same as earlier). Looking forward to a short sync.
